allow: Bash(python -c "from app.api import ai; print\('Import OK'\); print\([r.path for r in ai.router.routes]\)")
Bash(.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe -c "from app.api import ai; print\('Import OK'\); print\([r.path for r in ai.router.routes]\)")

PowerShell(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8000/api/ai/orientar" -Method POST -ContentType "application/json" -Body '{"description": "Recibí un llamado sospechoso de alguien que decía ser de mi banco"}' -UseBasicParsing 2>&1 | Select-Object StatusCode, StatusDescription)

PowerShell(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8000/openapi.json" -UseBasicParsing 2>&1 | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | python -c "import sys,json; data=json.load\(sys.stdin\); print\(list\(data['paths'].keys\(\)\)\)")

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8000/openapi.json" -UseBasicParsing 2>&1 | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load\(sys.stdin\); print\('/api/ai/orientar' in d['paths']\)")

PowerShell(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8000/openapi.json" -UseBasicParsing 2>&1 | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load\(sys.stdin\); print\(list\(d['paths'].keys\(\)\)\)")

hooks.command: powershell -Command "$content = $env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT; if ($content -match 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\s*=\s*sk-' -or $content -match 'SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY\s*=\s*ey') { Write-Host '⚠️  ALERTA DE SEGURIDAD: Posible secreto real detectado. Revisa el contenido antes de continuar.' }"

powershell -Command "$f = $env:CLAUDE_TOOL_RESULT_FILE_PATH; if (-not $f) { $f = $env:CLAUDE_FILE_PATH }; if ($f -and $f -match '\.py$') { $ruff = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe'; if (Test-Path $ruff) { & $ruff -m ruff check $f 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ } } }"

powershell -Command "$f = $env:CLAUDE_TOOL_RESULT_FILE_PATH; if (-not $f) { $f = $env:CLAUDE_FILE_PATH }; if ($f -and ($f -match '[/\\]prompts[/\\]' -or $f -match 'prompt_manifest')) { Write-Host '📋 Recuerda actualizar prompt_manifest.yaml si cambiaste la versión activa de un agente.' }"
